items.title: An etale chart by a separated scheme is a separated morphism and its fibre product is a separated scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that an etale morphism from a separated scheme U to an algebraic space X is separated, and that the fibre product U x_X U is a separated scheme (statement lines 991-997). The proof (proof lines 999-1036) reduces to a surjective chart, proves the separatedness of the fibre product through the separatedness of the diagonal morphism and the separatedness of U over the base, and concludes with the chart criterion for representable morphisms. H2: a three-step argument with three inputs, written out in full.
